class.name: HTMLView
class.brief_description: Control that draws a pure HTML/CSS document as a texture.
class.description: Draws an [HTMLDocument] into the control rectangle. Actions are delivered through Godot signals and bound [Callable]s rather than JavaScript.

members.member: Preferred render backend. The current checkpoint supports [constant BACKEND_AUTO] and [constant BACKEND_CPU].
If [code]true[/code], the view grabs keyboard focus when clicked.
Convenience access to the assigned document's inline HTML source.
Convenience access to the assigned document's HTML file path.
If [code]true[/code], the view accepts pointer input for HTML action activation.

signal.name: action_requested
signal.description: Emitted when the activation layer requests a Godot action.

signal.name: element_clicked
signal.description: Emitted when an HTML element is clicked.

signal.name: render_error
signal.description: Emitted when the renderer or action layer reports an error.

method.name: bind_action
method.description: Binds a Godot callable to an HTML action name.

method.name: has_action
method.description: Returns whether an action has a callable binding.

constants.constant: Automatically chooses the best available backend.
Uses the portable CPU texture backend.
